summary.text: Seth Blattman is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 9; he assumed office on January 9, 2023, and his current term ends on January 11, 2027.

paragraphs.text: He was born in New York, New York, graduated from Chaparral High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 2006 and a master's degree from UCLA in 2013.
His professional experience includes owning Forest Designs.
Ballotpedia reports that he did not file to run for re-election in 2026.
